title: Update etl4/sink/postgres.py::write_run - CTE DO NOTHING + ym kwarg
objective: Rewrite write_run so pipeline_runs INSERT uses the architecture.md section 4.4 CTE: ON CONFLICT (ym, source, method, noise) DO NOTHING RETURNING run_id, with a UNION ALL follow-up SELECT so callers receive the pre-existing run_id on skip. eval_results and deviation_events only populate on a NEWLY created run (no orphans; no accumulation).
blocked_by_sibling_task: T-16 (pipeline_runs.ym column + UNIQUE constraint). Not required to merge T-18 - the code fails informatively (psycopg.errors.UndefinedColumn) when the migration has not run. Smoke _t18() adds the column + constraint itself and tears them down, so it can run before T-16 lands.
unblocks: T-20 (run_matrix must pass ym= to write_run)

files_changed.note: test_matrix_csv_written_after_every_cell: stubs rm.write_run so the test's matrix-crash-safety invariant is independent of Postgres schema state (the old broad-except behavior silently absorbed the sink error; the new write_run propagates schema-level exceptions per architecture 4.4).

integration_points.reads: pipeline_runs (ON CONFLICT lookup + UNION ALL fallback SELECT)
integration_points.writes: pipeline_runs (one new row OR zero on conflict); eval_results (one row per metric, only on new); deviation_events (one row per dev, only on new)
consumers: etl4/bench/run_matrix.py (will pass ym under T-20 rewire)
etl4/run_pipeline.py:69 (does not yet pass ym; _resolve_ym falls back to metrics['run_date'] month, which was the pre-IMPR-01 implicit behavior - safe)

contract_deviations: None against architecture.md section 4.4 CTE shape.
notes: Fault-tolerant catch preserved: psycopg.OperationalError on connect (dev without Docker up) returns None with a log line. Schema-level errors (UndefinedColumn on missing ym, UndefinedObject on missing UNIQUE) propagate so operators see the missing T-16 migration. _resolve_ym precedence: explicit kwarg > metrics['ym'] > month-of metrics['run_date'] > utcnow month. Synthetic callers must pass ym='SYN-<seed>' explicitly (architecture 2.3); _resolve_ym does NOT invent a sentinel.
test_patch_rationale: test_matrix_csv_written_after_every_cell targets matrix.csv crash-safety (plan.md section 13). It monkeypatched _worker but not write_run; the old broad-except in write_run masked the fact that the test's Postgres has no ym column. Now that schema errors propagate (per architecture 4.4), the test must stub write_run to the sink to stay focused on its stated invariant. Not removal, not rename - no decisions.md entry needed per CLAUDE.md section 3.8.
